name: application-signature-pad
title: Signature Pad
description: A canvas signature drawing area with clear and undo actions, plus a typed-signature fallback for consent and agreement flows.
useWhen: A canvas signature drawing area with clear and undo actions, plus a typed-signature fallback for consent and agreement flows.
avoidWhen: Avoid signature pad when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Signature Pad uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
